newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania denies arms shipments to Rwanda.
newsitem.headline: Albania denies arms shipments to Rwanda.

text.p: Albania denied on Tuesday media reports that it had breached a United Nations arms embargo by smuggling military equipment to Rwanda.
"Albania has never engaged in arms traffic to Rwanda. Albania has never breached the UN embargo. It has never been engaged in smuggling and illegal traffic," a Defence Ministry statement said.
The ministry was responding to Albanian media reports that quoted documents found in an abandoned refugee camp in east Zaire.

According to the documents, a British-registered company arranged shipments of mortars, rifles and heavy machinegun ammunition to the former Rwandan government during the 1994 genocide despite a U.N. arms embargo.
The arms were sourced from countries including Albania and Israel, the documents said.

"Because of its...technical potential it is not practical to list Albania among those countries that are active in armament and ammunition sales," the Defence Ministry said. "There is nothing true in the (newspaper) articles."
